documents.text: WCMA (AM) WCMA (1600 AM, "Cima 103.7") is a radio station broadcasting a Spanish Tropical format. Licensed to Bayamon, Puerto Rico, it serves all of Puerto Rico. The station is currently owned by La Mas Z Radio, Inc., and shares with translator stations W279BU (103.7 FM) in San Juan and W241DE (96.1 FM), also licensed to Bayamon. it is operated by Cadena Cima, a subsidiary of RM Entertainment, Inc.
